# American English 埃森美語

> American English (Chinese name 埃森美語) is a local English cram school (補習班) in Banqiao (板橋), New Taipei City, Taiwan, taught 100% by certified American teachers. Classes are strictly capped at 12 students and cover kids' English (兒童美語) through junior-high English (國中英文) — Phonics, reading, conversation, and exam prep (劍橋兒童英檢 Cambridge YLE / GEPT 全民英檢 / 國中會考). Founded and personally taught by a University of Michigan graduate who holds a U.S. state teaching certificate.

## What makes it different
- 100% certified American (native) teachers — career educators, not short-term backpackers.
- Classes strictly capped at 12 students, so every child speaks in every lesson.
- The founder (University of Michigan graduate, U.S. state teaching certificate) personally teaches.
- Full-English immersion from the very first lesson — children speak, not just memorize for tests.
- Around 12 authentic American cultural / holiday programs per year (roughly one a month).
- Monthly-paid tuition with no long-term lock-in contract.
- Personalized attention and a 1-on-1 level assessment for every child.

## Key facts
- Brand: American English (Chinese: 埃森美語; short form 埃森).
- Location: 1F, No. 4, Lane 89, Zhongzheng Rd, Banqiao District, New Taipei City 220, Taiwan (新北市板橋區中正路89巷4號1樓).
- Walkable to three school catchment zones: 板橋國小 (5 min), 國光國小 (8 min), 大觀國小 (10 min).
- Contact: LINE https://lin.ee/W9J8TuQ · Phone +886-928-067-772 · Email cessenma@umich.edu
- Hours: Mon–Fri 14:00–21:00, Sat 09:00–17:00.
- Reputation: 4.9 / 5 from 208 Google reviews; ~94% re-enrollment rate; ~98% exam pass rate; 208+ families served.
- Trial: a paid 90-minute real class plus a 1-on-1 level assessment (預約試聽). This is NOT a free trial, and there is no enrollment contract.

## Programs (Phonics → exam-ready; ~18 semesters across 6 ability levels)
- 啟蒙 Foundation (幼大班–小一): Phonics / natural phonics, basic listening & speaking.
- 核心 Core (小二–小四): reading comprehension × speaking.
- 升學 Advancement (小五–小六): grammar & writing, Cambridge YLE, private-school interview prep.
- 國中 Junior high (小六–國三): 國中教育會考 English × GEPT.
- Exam targets: Cambridge YLE (Starters / Movers / Flyers), KET, GEPT 全民英檢, 國中教育會考英文.
